item.title: Re: Need Help in moving forward in co authoring
Re: Need Help in moving forward in co authoring
item.content:encoded:
Just post in the forums/chatroom that im looking for a co-author?

Well… you'd want to also try to workshop the draft/concept that you have to see if anyone is interested in just reading it to begin with, rather than expecting people to immediately show interest just because you're asking for a co-author.

item.title: Need Help in moving forward in co authoring
item.content:encoded:
Hello,

I have an idea that was greenlit, drafted, posted, and failed. A little disheartened to say the least, but I believe in this idea, think it's something the Foundation could use, and would like to keep moving forward. My main idea is I think I probably need a co author to help, but have no idea how to effectively find one, nor if any of this is even 'ok'.

If anyone could point me in the right direction I'd be thankful.
